chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings (Terapeak, last 12 months): 'Zeiss Ikon Contaflex Tessar 50mm', 'Contaflex Super B', 'Contaflex Pro-Tessar 35mm', 'Contaflex Distagon 35mm', 'Contaflex wide angle front lens'; compare sold prices for body with case versus extra front lens alone (extra lenses often sell separately for more than the body). Also LiveAuctioneers/Invaluable results for 'Contaflex' and Australian auction houses (Leski, Mossgreen, Theodore Bruce) sold results. Record sold only, with date and URL.
viewing_check: Read the extra lens name ring (Pro-Tessar 35mm f/3.2, Distagon 35mm f/4 or Sonnar 85mm; Sonnar/Distagon are worth more). Check the body nameplate model (Contaflex Super, Super B, IV or Beta). Check lens glass for haze, fungus and scratches, that the shutter fires and the mirror works, the meter needle, and the serial numbers on both lenses.
